wikipedia.title: Shimei
wikipedia.noteJa: 記事は「シメイ」という複数の人物を挙げ、レビ人の項目に歴代誌6章42節を参照しています。系譜上の枝を詳しく特定してはいません。
wikipedia.locator: Lead, lines 112–125, especially 124: the article enumerates multiple Shimeis and lists a Levite entry with 1 Chronicles 6:29, 42 references; it does not identify which genealogy branch the assigned 6:42 ancestor belongs to. Lines 113 and 139 describe Gershon’s son Shimei separately.
